errors.text: The proposed L12 order-parameter thresholds of approximately 0.8 for brittleness and 0.4 for ductility are invented and unsupported by either the target or the cited evidence.
None of the cited sources directly supports the claimed APBE-driven mechanism, L12 ordering behavior, jagged B2/FCC boundaries, or ductile-brittle-ductile transition in AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
